findings.passage: Simply pushing more gun restrictions might sound good in a press conference, but it does not stop evil people from committing these crimes.
findings.note: Statement in a House member news release after the Annunciation Church attack. He calls for action on mental illness, school security and repeat offenders, and says new gun restrictions do not stop such crimes. Release also lists mandatory minimum sentences for repeat gun criminals and straw purchasers.

findings.passage: While only the binary trigger ban was struck down, the court’s strong language highlights just how far the Legislature has strayed from its constitutional duty.
findings.note: Statement in a House member news release on a court ruling that struck down the binary trigger ban in the 2024 omnibus bill for breaking the single-subject rule. He criticises large omnibus bills and pledges to push single-subject bills.
subjects: gun law passed in a large omnibus bill
